title: Automated dispatch notifications unavailable for one fulfilment centre
alert_or_symptom: Automated dispatch notifications for orders processed by the North Fulfilment Centre cannot be sent, while notification traffic for other business units remains available.

technical_evidence.observation: All 186 automated dispatch-notification requests submitted for the North Fulfilment Centre between 09:05 and 09:20 failed with a generic HTTP 503 response, with no successful dispatch notification recorded.
Customer order confirmations and operational notifications for all other fulfilment centres continued to process successfully during the same period.
Twenty-three operations staff cannot send automated dispatch notifications. Staff are using the approved manual customer-contact procedure for priority dispatches.
The directly responsible technical component or failure condition has not been identified. The generic response does not establish where the notification request is failing.

service_impact.user_impact_description: Automated dispatch notifications are unavailable for the North Fulfilment Centre, affecting 23 operations staff and 186 notification attempts. Other notification workflows and order processing remain available.
service_impact.business_function_affected: Automated customer dispatch notifications for one fulfilment centre
service_impact.workaround_description: Operations staff can use the approved manual customer-contact procedure for priority dispatches.

environmental_context: The Notification Service is a Tier 3 standard service.
The affected dispatch-notification workflow supports one of several United Kingdom fulfilment centres.
Customer ordering, payment and warehouse dispatch processing continue to operate.
reported_unknowns: The directly responsible technical component or failure condition has not been identified.
It is not known at which stage the affected notification requests are failing.
The expected restoration time for automated dispatch notifications is unknown.
additional_context: No order-processing interruption, data loss, corruption or serious security exposure has been reported.
The approved manual procedure is currently keeping priority customer contacts within the operational service target.
